attBesluta.text: Pour une activité cuir temporaire c'est un outil efficace. La qualité sera a voir au fil de l'usage

This leather press worked great straight out of the box. I didn't have to adjust anything. I would recommend getting some various thickness of plastic sheets because different die heights, different thickness of leather will require it. This will save you from making the height adjustments on the machine itself. It's very heavy and works like a charm.
Prima machine. Jammer dat je zelf moet uitzoeken hoe alles werkt omdat er geen fatsoenlijke gebruiksaanwijzing bijzit.

So far, I have only used this to roll out flat sheets. It works surprisingly well. The first time I tried it, I rolled it way too thin because I was amazed at how easy it was and I didn't realize how thin I was making it. I look forward to trying to roll out wire as well.
Everything I expected and then some. It was well packed and of high quality. I would definetly buy again.
